news.title: Calamos bets protected Bitcoin ETFs can outlast crypto market swings
news.summary: As more than $1 billion exited spot Bitcoin ETFs last week, Calamos says investors are rotating into Bitcoin products with built-in downside protection.

news.title: Bitcoin's record holder supply hides a buyer drought, CryptoQuant says
news.summary: A record high in long-term holder supply typically signals conviction. CryptoQuant says it reflects a shortage of new buyers, a view echoed by weakening ETF demand and bearish prediction market odds.

news.title: Bitcoin, ether little-changed despite record stocks, falling oil and easing war fears
news.summary: Global stocks hit records and oil cracked on a tentative US-Iran ceasefire extension. Crypto stayed on the sidelines, with some analysts saying the next catalyst is regulatory, not geopolitical.

news.title: Bitcoin slides to April lows as crypto diverges from record-chasing U.S. equities
news.summary: Bitcoin's failed breakout above $83,000 is looking increasingly like a bear market signal, even as S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures notch gains and approach all-time highs.

news.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows reach record nine-day streak as investors pull $2.8 billion
news.summary: The longest run of withdrawals since U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs listed in January 2024 comes as bitcoin underperforms high-flying AI and semiconductor stocks.

news.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
